questions.question: Dictionary kya hoti hai?
questions.answer: Key-value pairs ka mapping. Real-world records jaise user, product, student data represent karne me useful.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: d[key] vs d.get(key)?
questions.answer: d[key] missing key par KeyError de sakta hai. get() missing key par default/None de sakta hai.

questions.question: items() ka use?
questions.answer: Key aur value dono ke saath loop karne ke liye, jaise for k,v in d.items().

questions.question: in dictionary me kya check karta hai?
questions.answer: By default keys check karta hai, values nahi.

questions.question: Frequency counting ka pattern?
questions.answer: freq[x] = freq.get(x, 0) + 1 - pehle current count lo, phir 1 add karo.

questions.question: Dictionary comprehension kya hai?
questions.answer: Expression + loop se new dict banana, jaise {x:x*x for x in nums}.
